def bspline_wlssolve(x, y, weights=None):

    if weights is not None and len(weights) != len(x):

    n = len(x)

    wkspace = gsl.gsl_bspline_alloc(k, nbreak)
    gsl.gsl_bspline_init(0.0, wkspace)

    cov = gsl.gsl_matrix_alloc(nw, nw)
    yvec = gsl.gsl_vector_alloc(n)
    wvec = gsl.gsl_vector_alloc(n) if weights else None

    else:

    coeffs = [gsl.gsl_vector_get(c, i) for i in range(nw)]
